title: Our Community Centre
intro: Toynbee Hall’s Community Centre is a welcoming place in the heart of East London, bringing local people together for support, activities and connection.

blocks.heading: A space for the community
paragraphs: The centre hosts advice services, LinkAge Plus activities, workshops, community events and opportunities to meet and learn.

blocks.heading: Find us
paragraphs: 28 Commercial Street, London, E1 6LS. Check the details of a particular service or activity before visiting.
